documents.title: Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Srivari Spices and Foods Limited reported robust financial results for H1 FY26 with revenue of Rs. 78.77 crores, EBITDA of Rs. 13.43 crore, and PAT of Rs. 7.20 crore. Management highlighted distribution expansions across modern trade and e-commerce platforms, along with recent product additions such as edible oils, soya chunks, and a planned entry into puja and devotional articles.

guidance.claim: Management stated that H2 will be better than H1 in terms of margins.
guidance.quote: So, that will be picked up very well. So, H2 will be better than H1.

guidance.claim: Management expects to utilize up to 30% of the oil capacity in H2.
guidance.quote: Now, we can utilize up to 30% in this H2.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the demand environment continues to be encouraging.
demand_outlook.quote: The demand environment continues to be encouraging and we are confident of sustaining the growth momentum in the second half.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the Indian soy protein market is projected to grow at a CAGR of approximately 6 percent from 2024 to 2029.
demand_outlook.quote: The Indian soy protein market is projected to grow at a CAGR of ~6% from 2024 –2029, driven by rising health awareness and higher protein consumption.

demand_outlook.claim: The company noted that over 70 percent of Indians do not consume the recommended daily protein intake based on Indian Market Research Bureau data.
demand_outlook.quote: Over 70% of Indians do not consume the recommended daily protein intake (Source: Indian Market Research Bureau).

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated they are planning to introduce a new business vertical focused on puja articles, devotional goods, festival-related items and allied products.
capex_expansion.quote: Looking ahead, we are planning to introduce a new business vertical focused on manufacturing, trading and distribution of puja articles, devotional goods, festival related items and allied products.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated they are planning to install a plant for soya chunks after two quarters.
capex_expansion.quote: Install the capacity later, after 2 quarters.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated they are planning for an expansion plan for atta and spices after the next financial year.
capex_expansion.quote: After the next financial year, we have to go for the expansion plan.

capex_expansion.claim: The company launched a new oil plant and officially introduced its products in Mumbai, Maharashtra.
capex_expansion.quote: Launched a new oil plant and officially introduced its products in Mumbai, Maharashtra on 28 July 2025 .

capex_expansion.claim: The board approved the alteration of the Objects Clause of the Memorandum of Association to enable a new line of business focused on manufacturing, trading, and dealing in puja devotional articles and goods.
capex_expansion.quote: Note: The Board of Directors had approved the alteration of the Objects Clause of the Memorandum of Association, and the same has since been duly approved by the members at the 6th AGM held on 30th September 2025. The MOA has now been amended to enable this new line of business.

capex_expansion.claim: The company launched a new oil production plant on May 10, 2025.
capex_expansion.quote: we launched our edible oil on 10th May 2025 and it started its commercial production on 10th May 2025.

capex_expansion.claim: The oil plant has an installed capacity of 7,200 tons per annum.
capex_expansion.quote: Regarding oil, we have installed capacity of 7,200 tons per annum but this plant is yet to be commercialized.

margins_costs.claim: Management reported an EBITDA margin of 17.05% and a PAT margin of 9.14% for H1 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: Our profitability remained healthy with EBITDA margin of 17.05% and PAT margin of 9.14%.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that the oil division is currently at EBITDA breakeven and not making losses.
margins_costs.quote: No, exactly breakeven only, not in the losses.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted that net profit decreased due to depreciation charges from the new plant.
margins_costs.quote: See PAT has been decreased due to the new plant commencement and we have claimed the depreciation of the 6 months because of that PAT has been decreased, but our overall numbers are positive.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated the installed capacity and utilization for spices, atta, and oil.
orders_capacity.quote: For Spices, we have an installed capacity of 3,600 tons and we have utilized 2,637 tons. And when it comes to Atta, installed capacity is 14,400 tons and we have utilized 12,650 tons. When it comes to Oil, we have installed capacity of 7,200 tons and we have utilized 720 tons.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's spices and masala segment has an installed capacity of 3,600 tons per annum with 2,637 tons utilized.
orders_capacity.quote: For spices and masalas, we have an installed capacity of 3,600 tons per annum with the current utilization at about 2,637 tons.

orders_capacity.claim: The atta segment has an installed capacity of 14,400 tons per annum with 12,650 tons utilized.
orders_capacity.quote: When it comes to atta, 14,400 tons per annum installed capacity and we have utilized 12,650 tons.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company faced delays in the rights issue and oil plant setup, which impacted financial performance.
risks_headwinds.quote: And second thing, because of that our oil part was delayed so we couldn't get the numbers reach up to the mark as we promised.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated they are planning to launch the new puja and devotional products vertical roughly in January.
management_commitments.quote: In Jan, roughly in the Jan, we are going to launch.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated they will plan for export market expansion in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Definitely. But in FY '27. Next year, we will plan for the expansion. Next year, we are into the planning for that.

management_commitments.claim: The company is planning its next growth chapter with the launch of a new business vertical focusing on puja devotional articles and goods.
management_commitments.quote: Srivari Spices & Foods is planning its next growth chapter with the launch of a new business vertical

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to start exports in the second half of the year.
management_commitments.quote: but definitely we are the second, H2, we are going to start the export.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
